rules.sentence: This study demonstrates that moderate or severe tricuspid regurgitation is associated with an increased mortality risk, independent of pulmonary pressures and right ventricular dysfunction.

Wang Wang N, Fulcher J, Abeysuriya N, McGrady M, Wilcox I, Celermajer D, Lal S. Tricuspid regurgitation is associated with increased mortality independent of pulmonary pressures and right heart failure: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
